latest_evidence.probe: live GitHub contents-API stale-SHA conflict/no-write probe
latest_evidence.scope: One dedicated role-local scratch file under research_workers_clean_g1/cross_field/experiments/. Created the file, performed one update using the then-current blob SHA, then attempted one second update using the now-stale pre-update SHA. GitHub returned HTTP 409 mismatch. Exact readback showed stage=correct_update and blob 8d0c2a6bfb61b4aa97c6f5bd97af60ab8ff3c339, so the stale write was not applied.
latest_evidence.semantic_conclusion: Within this exact GitHub contents-API scope, optimistic concurrency by expected blob SHA rejects a stale writer without overwriting the current value. This is positive provider-specific evidence for duplicate/conflict safety, not proof of lost-response idempotency, provider-independent persistence, or full Phase-1 parity.
